$comment: Declarations the environment-contract census cannot derive. Every entry carries a reason; an entry without one is rejected by the test. Names only, never values.

environmentSpecific.AUTH_DISABLED: development-only bypass switch; refused in staging/production
environmentSpecific.DEV_SOCIAL_METRICS_MOCK: development-only synthetic metrics; refused in staging/production
environmentSpecific.DEV_AUTH_ENDPOINT_ENABLED: development-only token helper; refused in staging/production
environmentSpecific.ALLOW_RBAC_SHADOW_IN_PRODUCTION: temporary production/staging escape hatch while RBAC_PERSISTED_AUTHORITY is still SHADOW; development runs in shadow by default and never needs it

templatePrefixes.STAGING_: variables of the staging harness and provisioning scripts, documented in the root .env.staging (scripts/ read them; the API does not)
templatePrefixes.RBAC_HARNESS_: RBAC shadow harness inputs (test/rbac-shadow-harness), documented in the root .env.staging
templatePrefixes.SEED_: operational seed inputs read by one-shot seed scripts and documented in the root templates

templateOnly.API_URL: read by packages/config (server-side helper) and verification scripts, not by the API runtime
templateOnly.DB_VERIFY_ENABLED: CI gate variable read by scripts/db-verify-gate.mjs, documented for operators

unvalidatedReads.SEED_ORG_ID: one-shot seed input (database/seeds), not API runtime configuration
unvalidatedReads.SEED_TENANT_ID: one-shot seed input (database/seeds), not API runtime configuration

acceptedSecretDefaults.ENCRYPTION_KEY: documented residual (docs/engineering/security.md): the schema defaults to all-zero and rejects it in staging and production; EncryptionService fails closed outside development, local and test
acceptedSecretDefaults.ADMIN_QUEUES_PASS: development-only fallback of the queue dashboard; admin-queues.module.ts refuses to start it in production-like environments without the variable
acceptedSecretDefaults.ADMIN_QUEUES_USER: development-only fallback of the queue dashboard (same guard as ADMIN_QUEUES_PASS)

buildInjected.VITE_COMMIT_SHA: injected at build time by apps/web/vite.config.mjs (define), never an environment variable

pendingTemplateCleanup.OPENAI_BASE_URL: documented in the root .env.production but read by no code; removing the line needs authorization to edit a protected template (the R1 authorization covers comments only)

pendingTemplateAdditions.BUILD_SHA: optional variable documented only in the development template: adding it to the protected staging/production templates needs authorization to edit protected files (the R1 authorization covers comments only)
